# Version 4.150.5
> **RAW decoding disabled** · Released September 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.5) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.5)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.5/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.5/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.5 disables RAW and DNG image decoding. Use a dedicated RAW-image decoder before passing supported raster data to SkiaSharp.

## Breaking Changes

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — The bundled codec no longer decodes RAW or DNG images. Decode these formats with a dedicated library and provide a supported raster image to SkiaSharp instead. ([#5184](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5184))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.5

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
